test_title: PYST 2: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 20 Oct 2021 Shift 1)

question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is '**Stagnent**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Among the given options, the incorrectly spelt word is '**Stagnent**'. • Its correct spelling is '**stagnant**'. • It means** '(used about business, etc.) not active; not developing'.** [(व्‍यापार आदि) गतिहीन, सुस्‍त, मंद; विकासरुद्घ] • *Example: a stagnant **economy**...* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Continent**: any of the world's main continuous expanses of land (Europe, Asia, Africa, North and South America, Australia, Antarctica). • **Imminent**: (usually used about something unpleasant) almost certain to happen very soon. [(प्रायः अप्रिय बात) बहुत शीघ्र लगभग निश्‍चित रूप से घटित होने वाली; सन्निकट, आसन्‍न, अवश्‍यंभावी] • **Exponent**: a person who supports an idea, a theory, etc., and persuades others that it is good. (मत, वाद आदि का समर्थक और प्रचारक) 39:T1370, The erroneous part is** 'what them children'.**
